title: Battery life and replacement
text: The Fjordlight Tag runs on a single CR2032 coin cell. In normal mode the tag reports its position every fifteen minutes and the cell lasts about eighteen months. Power save mode lowers the reporting rate to once an hour, which stretches battery life to roughly three years. Cold weather shortens battery life. Below minus ten degrees Celsius, expect around forty percent less runtime. To replace the cell, twist the back cover counter-clockwise with a coin, swap the battery with the positive side facing up, and close the cover until it clicks. The tag keeps its pairing after a battery swap, so there is no need to set it up again.

title: Pairing a tag with the app
text: Install the Fjordlight app from the App Store or Google Play and sign in. Tap Add device and hold the tag close to the phone. Press the button on the tag once; the LED blinks blue while it searches and turns solid green when pairing succeeds. Bluetooth and location permissions must be granted, otherwise the app cannot find the tag. If pairing fails, hold the button for ten seconds to reset the tag, then try again. One tag can be paired with one account at a time. Share access with family members from the Sharing screen instead of pairing twice.

title: Water and dust resistance
text: The tag is rated IP67. It survives being submerged in one metre of fresh water for up to thirty minutes. It is not designed for swimming, diving or saltwater use, and long exposure to seawater can corrode the contacts. After it gets wet, dry the tag and let the battery compartment air out before closing it. Dust and sand cannot enter the sealed housing when the back cover is closed properly.

title: Plans and pricing
text: The Basic plan is free and includes live location for up to three tags and seven days of location history. The Pro plan costs 49 kroner per month and adds unlimited tags, one year of history, geofence alerts and priority support. Business customers with more than fifty tags can request volume pricing from the sales team. You can cancel Pro at any time from account settings; you keep Pro features until the end of the paid period. Refunds are available within fourteen days of the first purchase.

title: Geofence alerts
text: A geofence is a virtual boundary around a place such as home, a cabin or a parking area. Pro users can draw up to twenty zones in the map view and choose whether to get an alert when a tag enters, leaves, or both. Alerts arrive as push notifications within about two minutes of the tag crossing the boundary. Because the tag only reports every fifteen minutes in normal mode, very short visits can be missed; switch the tag to live mode for tighter tracking.

title: Privacy and data storage
text: Location data is encrypted in transit and at rest and is stored on servers in Norway. Fjordlight never sells location data to third parties. Basic users keep seven days of history and Pro users keep one year; older points are deleted automatically. You can export all your data as a CSV file or delete your account and every stored location from the privacy settings. Anti-stalking protection warns nearby phones if an unknown tag travels with them for more than an hour.

title: Finding a lost item
text: Mark a tag as lost in the app to turn on lost mode. In lost mode, any phone running the Fjordlight app that passes nearby reports the tag's location anonymously, and you get a notification. You can also make the tag play a loud sound when you are within Bluetooth range, roughly forty metres outdoors. Add a phone number or message in lost mode so a finder who scans the QR code on the back can contact you.

title: Troubleshooting connection problems
text: If the app shows the tag as offline, first check that Bluetooth is on and the app has background location permission. Walls, metal cases and car bodies weaken the signal. A blinking red LED means the battery is almost empty. If the location has not updated for more than a day, remove the battery for ten seconds and put it back to restart the tag. Firmware updates install automatically over Bluetooth when the phone is nearby and charging.

title: Technical specifications
text: Dimensions are 38 by 38 by 7 millimetres and the tag weighs 9 grams with the battery. It uses Bluetooth Low Energy 5.3 and a low-power LTE-M radio for reporting when no phone is nearby. Position is calculated with GPS outdoors and Wi-Fi scanning indoors, with typical accuracy of five to fifteen metres. The operating temperature range is minus twenty to plus sixty degrees Celsius.

title: Orders, shipping and returns
text: Orders placed before 14:00 on weekdays ship the same day from the warehouse in Trondheim. Delivery inside Norway takes one to three working days; Sweden and Denmark take three to five. Unused tags in original packaging can be returned within thirty days for a full refund. The tag has a two year warranty that covers manufacturing defects but not damage from misuse or seawater.
